notes: Truths of the tiered AverageEffect cells derived from the stated linear laws.

oracle.method: exact path algebra over the stated linear laws: the closure functional of a law linear in (t, z, u) is the coefficient of t; the scenario effects are the total (beta_t + beta_m gamma_mt) and direct (beta_t) effects
oracle.independence_basis: The generator derives each truth from the stated structural coefficients with rational arithmetic; it imports no Antecedent code and no statistics package. The shared object is the stated data-generating law, which the test's generators also encode, so this checks that the product recovers the law's functional, not that the law is the right model.
oracle.historical_exposure: The constants were first written as test-source literals beside the generators; this reference was written afterwards from the law descriptions alone with no product implementation source consulted.
